question: In the review of lithium-mediated ammonia electrosynthesis, what ammonia faradaic efficiency did LiTFSI give in the gas diffusion electrode flow electrolyser with a PtAu anode?
rendered: According to the review, LiTFSI gave a poor ammonia faradaic efficiency of 18% in the gas diffusion electrode flow electrolyser with a PtAu anode, due to sulfur-based decomposition products poisoning the PtAu HOR catalyst.

prompt.system: You answer questions about one document, "Pathways to sustainable lithium-mediated ammonia electrosynthesis: tuning reaction environment and advancing reactor design", using only what that document contains.
